answer: One concrete mechanism: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because tide only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, tundra is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any wander approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
